description: HAL SPI1 full duplex with PA7 MOSI wired to PA6 MISO: 64-byte TransmitReceive in mode 0, mode 3 LSB-first, 16-bit frames and with hardware CRC, 'spi loopback ok' on USART1
expect:
72 MHz. SPI1 master full duplex: PA5 SCK and PA7 MOSI AF push-pull, PA6 MISO input; a wire connects PA7 to PA6. USART1 PA9/PA10 115200 8N1. Once after reset: 'SPI1 loopback (PA7 MOSI -> PA6 MISO)
', then four blocking HAL_SPI_TransmitReceive passes of tx[i] = 37*i + 11, each compared with what was sent: mode 0 MSB first 9 MHz -> 'mode 0: 64 bytes ok
'; mode 3 LSB first 18 MHz -> 'mode 3 lsb: 64 bytes ok
'; mode 1 16-bit frames 4.5 MHz -> '16-bit: 32 words ok
'; mode 0 with hardware CRC (polynomial 7, the CRC frame comes back and is checked) -> 'crc: 64 bytes ok, crc 0xNN
'; then 'spi loopback ok
' and WFI. A difference prints '<pass>: mismatch at byte N: sent 0xSS got 0xRR
' and stops (without the wire the first pass fails this way); a HAL error prints '<pass>: HAL status S, ErrorCode 0xE
'. No machine checks: the checks runner cannot place the PA7-PA6 wire; tests/mcu/stm32f1/spi-firmware.test.ts runs both variants.

circuit: USART1: virtual terminal on PA9 (TX) / PA10 (RX)

boot.USART1:
SPI1 loopback (PA7 MOSI -> PA6 MISO)
mode 0: 64 bytes ok
mode 3 lsb: 64 bytes ok
16-bit: 32 words ok
crc: 64 bytes ok, crc 0x1E
spi loopback ok
